notice: SYNTHETIC DEVELOPMENT DATA (AJI-030). Every company, posting and salary in this file is invented for NERO development and testing. None of it is a real job, none of it was copied or scraped from a job site, and no record carries a posting or application URL. Dates are relative offsets (days before / after the day a run happens), resolved by DevelopmentDatasetJobSource, so the active/expired mix never goes stale.

records.title: Senior Backend Engineer
records.description: Harborline Health is building a patient scheduling platform used by clinics across the country. As a Senior Backend Engineer you will design and operate the Python services behind appointment booking, reminders and clinic analytics.
responsibilities: Design, build and operate REST APIs in Python and FastAPI.
Own PostgreSQL schema design, migrations and query performance.
Deploy services to AWS with Docker and Terraform.
Review code and mentor two mid-level engineers.
requirements: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.

records.title: Machine Learning Engineer
records.description: Lumen Ridge Analytics builds demand-forecasting products for retailers. You will train, evaluate and ship machine learning models that forecast inventory needs for thousands of stores.
responsibilities: Train and evaluate forecasting models with PyTorch and scikit-learn.
Build feature pipelines with pandas and Spark.
Deploy models behind Python services on AWS.
Monitor model quality and retrain when data drifts.
requirements: 3+ years of experience building machine learning systems.
Proficiency in Python, pandas and scikit-learn.
Experience deploying models to production on AWS or GCP.

records.title: Frontend Engineer
records.description: Cedar & Pine Commerce runs an online marketplace for independent furniture makers. You will build fast, accessible shopping experiences in React and TypeScript from our Manhattan office.
responsibilities: Build product listing, cart and checkout interfaces in React.
Improve accessibility and page performance.
Work with designers to turn prototypes into production UI.
Write unit and end-to-end tests.

records.title: Data Engineer (Contract)
records.description: Meridian Freight Systems needs a contract data engineer for a six-month project consolidating shipment tracking data into a new analytics warehouse.
responsibilities: Build batch data pipelines in SQL and Python.
Orchestrate pipelines with Airflow.
Model warehouse tables for the analytics team.
Document pipelines and hand them over at the end of the contract.
requirements: Experience with Airflow or a similar orchestrator.
Experience with a cloud data warehouse.

records.title: DevOps Engineer
records.description: Bluewater Civic Software builds permitting and licensing software for city governments. You will run the infrastructure that keeps those services available for residents.
responsibilities: Maintain Kubernetes clusters and CI/CD pipelines.
Manage infrastructure as code with Terraform.
Improve monitoring, alerting and incident response.
Harden systems to meet government security requirements.
requirements: 4+ years of DevOps or site reliability experience.
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker and Terraform.
Ability to obtain a public trust clearance is preferred.

records.title: Junior Software Engineer
records.description: An entry-level role on Harborline Health's clinic tools team. You will learn our Python and React stack while shipping features with support from a mentor.
responsibilities: Fix bugs and ship small features across the stack.
Write tests for new and existing code.

requirements: 0-2 years of professional experience; recent graduates welcome.
Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience.

records.title: Data Analyst
records.description: Lakeshore Mutual Insurance is looking for a data analyst to turn claims data into dashboards and recommendations for the operations team.
responsibilities: Write SQL queries to analyze claims and policy data.
Build and maintain Tableau dashboards.
Present findings to operations managers.
requirements: 2+ years of experience in a data analysis role.
Experience with Tableau or Power BI.

records.title: Cloud Security Engineer (Contract)
records.description: Ironbridge Payments is hiring a 12-month contract cloud security engineer to strengthen the security of its AWS payment infrastructure ahead of a compliance audit. No salary range is stated for this contract.
responsibilities: Review and harden AWS IAM policies and network configuration.

Support the team through a PCI DSS audit.

records.title: Full Stack Engineer

records.title: Site Reliability Engineer

responsibilities: Define and track service level objectives.
Lead incident response and blameless postmortems.
Automate capacity planning for live events.
Improve observability across Kubernetes services.

records.title: QA Automation Engineer (Contract)

records.title: AI Engineer
